object.description: Store object directory name (store backend only).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the verified artifact; empty for `image`-provided packages.

source.description: `group:<version>`, `image` (built into the base image) or `system` (found installed, not by us).

description:
The runnable package set recorded by the updater (`<store>/installed.json`). planner, CLI and dashboards read
it to show installed versions; only the updater writes it.

generation.description: Local activation counter; increases with every switch (including rollbacks).

selected.description:
Packages the operator selected explicitly (container `MEDUZA_NP_COMPONENTS` or `install`); the rest are
fixed components or dependencies.

title: InstalledSet
